integrity: Uniform argument and reproducible standard-library finite corroboration. Original source dating from arXiv v1. Self-review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: For all odd \(n\ge3\) only. Ordinary open neighborhood complexes; the homotopy equivalence is nonequivariant, and no result is asserted for even folded cubes. Finite scripts check \(n=3,5,7,9\); the uniform all-n proof relies on established graph fundamental group theory. Unindexed equivalent prior work cannot be ruled out.
title: The neighborhood complexes of odd folded hypercubes are wedges of two-spheres
